# SPEC-18 — Attachments

> **Spec ID:** SPEC-18 · **Consumed by:** SPEC-06

## 1. Overview
Photos hang off plant batches.

## 2. Storage

### 2.4 Streaming
Photos are streamed, never loaded whole.

## 5. Sharing
A share link shows one photo.

## 6. Acceptance checks

1. A photo uploads.
2. A photo streams.
3. A share link opens.
4. A share link expires.
5. A thumbnail appears.
6. A deleted photo is gone from shares.
